About ACME Switchgears

Your Reliable Industrial Supply Partner

ACME Switchgears is a trader, wholesaler and distributor of industrial electrical and automation products, serving industries across Tamil Nadu from our base in George Town, Chennai.

We stock products from established brands such as Autonics, Kinco, Delta and Schneider Electric, and our commitment is quality products at competitive prices with timely delivery and dependable service.
